chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me. He said: al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Dallal narrated to us. He said: Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Muzni narrated to us. He said: Uthman ibn Sa'id narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ghurab narrated to us, from Musa ibn Qais al-Hadhrami, from Salama ibn Kuhail, from Ayadh ibn Ayadh, from his father, who said:

Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, passed by a group of people among whom was Salman, may God have mercy on him. So Salman said to them: 'Stand up and hold on to this man, for by God, no one other than he will inform you of the secrets of your Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny.'

key_terms.حجزة: Waist-band or belt - metaphor for clinging closely and following
key_terms.سر نبيكم: Secrets of your Prophet - intimate prophetic knowledge known only to Ali
key_terms.سلمان: Salman al-Farsi - esteemed companion known for his devotion to Ali

ai.seo_question: What did Salman al-Farsi say about Ali ibn Abi Talib's knowledge of the Prophet?
ai.summary: The narrator's father witnessed Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) passing by a group that included Salman al-Farsi. Upon seeing Ali, Salman urged the group to 'be attached to this man,' swearing by God that no one besides Ali could inform them of the intimate secrets of their Prophet. This hadith highlights Salman's recognition of Ali's unique knowledge and authority.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me from al-Qasim Ibn Muhammad al-Dallal, who reported from Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Muzni, who reported from Uthman ibn Sa'id, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Ghurab, from Musa ibn Qais al-Hadhrami, from Salama ibn Kuhail, from Ayadh ibn Ayadh, from his father, who said:

Once ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) passed by a group of people among whom was Salman, may Allah bless him with mercy. So Salman told them: "Be attached to this man (i.e. ‘Ali) for no one else will inform you of the intimate things about your Prophet except he."
